columns.name: Action
columns.description: The action completed by the event: Deployed, Updated, or Deleted.

columns.name: DeploymentID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the LTI Advantage deployment.

columns.name: ClientID
columns.description: Unique identifier used in OAuth2 authentication, assigned by the platform when the LTI tool is registered.

columns.name: DeploymentName
columns.description: The name for the deployment.

columns.name: IsDeploymentEnabled
columns.description: If false, it is not possible to do any launches for this tool or make any API calls for the extensions.

columns.name: HasAssignmentsAndGrades
columns.description: If true, the Assignments and grades services (AGS) extension is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasDeepLinking
columns.description: If true, the Deep Linking extension is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasNamesAndRoles
columns.description: If true, the Names and Roles Provisioning Services (NRPS) extension is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasSubmissionReview
columns.description: If true, the Submission Review extension is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasActivityItemProfile
columns.description: If true, the Activity Item Profile extension is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasPlatformNotificationService
columns.description: If true, the Platform Notification Service is enabled for this deployment.

columns.name: HasContextCopy
columns.description: If true, the Context Copy message is enabled for this deployment. The Platform Notification Service must also be enabled.

columns.name: ModifiedBy
columns.description: The ID of the Brightspace user that modified the deployment record.

columns.name: Anonymous
columns.description: If true, no user information is sent during launch.

columns.name: PreProvisioningEnabled
columns.description: If true, all users in the course are included whether they have performed a launch or not. If false, only users that have performed a launch are included for NRPS and AGS Services.

columns.name: SendOrgUnitInfo
columns.description: If true, Org Unit Id, Course Name, Course Code, Org Unit Type, LIS Course Offering Sourcedid, and LIS Course Section Sourcedid can be included in the launch.

columns.name: SendUserFirstName
columns.description: If true, user first name can be sent during launch.

columns.name: SendUserMiddleName
columns.description: If true, user middle name is included in the data sent via NRPS.

columns.name: SendUserLastName
columns.description: If true, user last name can be sent during launch.

columns.name: SendUserEmail
columns.description: If true, user email address can be sent during launch.

columns.name: SendBrightspaceUserID
columns.description: If true, D2L user ID can be sent during launch.

columns.name: SendBrightspaceUsername
columns.description: If true, D2L username is sent during launch.

columns.name: SendBrightspaceOrgDefinedId
columns.description: If true, D2L Org Defined ID can be sent for this deployment.

columns.name: SendLinkTitle
columns.description: If true, LTI Link Title is sent during launch.

columns.name: SendLinkDescription
columns.description: If true, LTI Link Description is sent during launch.

columns.name: OpenAsExternal
columns.description: If true, the majority of new links created under the deployment open in an external window. If false, new links open inline.

columns.name: AutoMigrateLinks
columns.description: If true, automatic migration can occur for links that match this deployment.

columns.name: IsSharedToManyOrgUnits
columns.description: If true, the deployment is shared to multiple org units.

columns.name: AutoCreateGrades
columns.description: If true, the Auto Create Grade Items setting is enabled.

columns.name: IncludeInFinalGrade
columns.description: If true, grades created by LTI links for this deployment are included in the final grade calculation.

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Date and time (UTC) when the user created or modified the deployment.

columns.name: HasAssetProcessor
columns.description: If true, the Asset Processor Services are enabled for this deployment. The Platform Notification Service and Deeplinking must also be enabled.
